name: Chisel
text: To kick off the analysis, I propose we start by cloning the entire repository from GitHub using the command `git clone https://github.com/example/repo.git` into a local directory named `analysis_repo`. This will give us access to the full source code and commit history. Next, I'll run `git log --all --numstat > commit_history.txt` to extract the commit history and save it to a file for further analysis, which should yield around 500-700 lines of output.

name: Sift
